errors.message: [unconfirmed-P04] Unauthorized to access requested resource. The API token is missing the 'Access: Apps and Policies — Edit' permission. Add the scope to the token in the Cloudflare dashboard (My Profile > API Tokens) and store it as the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN repo secret.
